personality_one_liner: A sharp, high-contrast operational command center prioritizing speed, big touch targets, and instant legibility for a fast-paced motorcycle workshop.

spacing.rule: Use dense utility-driven spacing. Apply fixed bottom paddings for sticky CTAs. Large touch targets (min 48pt) are mandatory.

dont's: Do not use blur or glassmorphism. This is a Brutalist utility app. Keep surfaces opaque and borders sharp.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Role-based entry (Owner, Kasir, Mekanik, Partman) via username/password.

states.error: Red inline text with retry button

screens.layout: Hero image at the top with a gradient scrim. Brutalist form fields (sharp borders, labels above inputs). Massive primary 'MASUK' button at the bottom.

screens.name: Dashboard (Role-based)
screens.purpose: Provides role-specific shortcuts (e.g., Owner sees Omzet cards and Excel Export; Mekanik sees assigned tasks).
screens.layout: Top section features prominent mono-font metrics (Omzet/Tasks). Main area contains large, square action buttons (min 48x48dp touch targets) with text labels. 2pt borders separate modules rigidly.

screens.name: Antrian Servis (Queue)
screens.purpose: Live list of vehicles being serviced with status badges.

states.empty: Illustration of empty workshop, 'Tidak ada antrian.'

screens.layout: Single-column edge-to-edge list. Each row displays Queue Number (e.g., A-001) in JetBrains Mono. High contrast status badges (Yellow, Blue, Green, Red). A large sticky floating action button '+ TRANSAKSI BARU' at bottom right for Kasir.

screens.name: Detail Transaksi & POS
screens.purpose: Full workflow from complaints to mechanic updates to cashier payment.
screens.layout: Contextual details grouped in brutalist cards (Customer, Vehicle, Jasa, Parts). Large action buttons to 'Tambah Jasa' or 'Tambah Part'. Fixed sticky bottom container showing 'TOTAL BAYAR' and a massive 'BAYAR SEKARANG' button for Kasir.

screens.name: Inventori Suku Cadang (Partman)
screens.purpose: Manage part stock, barcode scanning, and search.

states.empty: No parts found. 'Scan atau cari part.'

screens.layout: Persistent sticky search bar and barcode scan button at the top. Single-column list of items displaying stock counts in mono font. Edit buttons are clearly labeled.

hero_login.alt: Mechanic holding an engine in a workshop

hero_inventory.alt: Hardware store shelf with organized parts

hero_engine_detail.alt: Close up of shiny motorcycle engine components

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Brutalist Mobile LIGHT personality: 0 radius, 2pt hard borders, no shadows, high-contrast layouts.
Use JetBrainsMono (or a similar Mono font) for all financial numbers, queue tickets (e.g., A-001), and stock quantities. Use Space Grotesk for everything else.
Max font weight allowed across the app is 500 (Medium). Use size for hierarchy, not heavier weights.
BANNED COLORS: No blues, purples, or indigos anywhere (except the specific blue #3B82F6 requested for 'DIPROSES' status). Use the provided Orange and Black palette heavily.
Implement the Status colors strictly as requested: MENUNGGU (Yellow), DIPROSES (Blue), SELESAI (Green), DIBATALKAN (Red).
All primary buttons must be massive, text-labeled (not just icons), and provide clear touch targets (min 48pt).
Detail Transaksi & POS screen MUST feature a fixed sticky container at the bottom with Total Cost and a primary CTA (like 'BAYAR' or 'SIMPAN') so it remains accessible over scrolling content.
Include an Audit Trail timeline component for tracking transaction history. Use sharp lines and mono timestamps.
